log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Politoed

decisions.rationale: Mega Floette. Lead Maushold+Floette: FM/FG enables safe Mega + Moonblast/LoR vs Arch/Scizor/Grimm; TidyUp/PBomb pressure. Back Arcanine deletes Mega Scizor and Intim chips; Annihilape breaks Arch/Stamina and answers screens. Bench Pult/Basc; rain answered by Ape CC and late switches.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Arch+Politoed rain, Mega Scizor, Prankster Grimm clay, Noivern sash, Staraptor. Our plan: Mega Floette Fairy Aura + Maushold FG/FM; H-Arcanine Intim/LO delete Scizor chip Arch; Annihilape Defiant/RageFist break Arch. Pult speed vs Noivern; Basc Adapt rain/LR late. Avoid hard commit into Prankster FakeOut turn1. Wide Intim/FG into Floette/RageFist.

decisions.rationale: Mega Scizor. Rain core leads: Drizzle sets rain passively—Electro Shot fires instantly (130 BP+SpA boost), fire weakened. Archaludon Draco Meteor OHKOs Dragapult (105-243%); Politoed Ice Beam breaks sash (40-91%). Noivern (192 Spe, Hurricane 100% acc in rain) cleans up; Scizor-Mega resists Fairy + Bullet Punch priority for Floette endgame.
decisions.notebook: Electro Shot instant in rain (verified). Hurricane 100% accuracy in rain (verified). Archaludon Draco Meteor guaranteed OHKO Dragapult 105-243% but Focus Sash saves. Politoed Ice Beam vs Dragapult 40-91% breaks sash cannot OHKO. Floette Light of Ruin vs Archaludon 50-144% neutral not guaranteed OHKO. Dragapult Draco Meteor vs Archaludon 35-106% neutral not guaranteed OHKO. Floette-Eternal base Spe 92 Modest raw 112-144. Opponent Dragapult Focus Sash Timid 178-213. Annihilape Defiant punishes Intimidate—avoid Staraptor vs Annihilape. Key plan: rain core lead, Protect Archaludon vs double-targets, break Dragapult sash with Ice Beam then Draco Meteor. Noivern 192 outspeeds all except max Dragapult. Scizor-Mega Fairy-neutral + priority BP. Watch Maushold Follow Me redirect—Protect through it then target freely next turn.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 1 (Politoed) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Rain WB/FC OHKO either; FM redirects so Mega Floette free Fairy hit. LoR Poli max chip (Aura) through Sitrus; Arch Stamina irrelevant on special. Keep Maus FG support if they misaim.

decisions.rationale: Protect Archaludon to deny Follow Me + Light of Ruin (50-144% possible KO). Weather Ball Maushold does 34-124% (possible OHKO with rain+STAB). If Follow Me redirects, same target anyway. Next turn Follow Me is gone and full-HP Archaludon Flash Cannons Floette SE. Standard safe turn-1 play; risk is they predict Protect and target Politoed, but no reads exist yet so they likely hit Archaludon.

Politoed Weather Ball in rain = 100 BP Water STAB+rain, 34-124% vs Maushold (possible OHKO). Floette Light of Ruin vs Politoed 31.5-101.8% possible OHKO.

decisions.rationale: Floette at 41% is the priority KO target. Scizor-Mega resists Fairy, has priority Bullet Punch (SE vs Floette, ~84% KO at 41%) and Close Combat (SE vs Maushold). Noivern is weak to Fairy and only hits neutrally. Archaludon likely survives Moonblast (45-102%, not guaranteed OHKO); Floette avoids Light of Ruin recoil at 41%. Next turn: Scizor-Mega BP finishes Floette while Archaludon threatens Flash Cannon/Electro Shot.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Politoed fainted T1 to Floette Light of Ruin. Rain 5 turns left. Scizor should Mega Evolve on entry—BP priority SE vs Floette, CC SE vs Maushold. Archaludon Flash Cannon ~98% KO chance vs Floette at 41% if unredirected. Floette Light of Ruin 1/2 recoil—at 41% HP, using it risks self-KO; expect Moonblast instead (45-102% vs Archaludon, not guaranteed OHKO). Maushold Follow Me redirects single-target moves—watch for it protecting Floette. Opponent back: Arcanine-Hisui (Fire, 4x threat to Scizor), Annihilape (Defiant—no Intimidate), Dragapult (Focus Sash, 178-213 Spe), Basculegion (Adaptability, Aqua Jet priority). Plan: KO Floette via Scizor-Mega BP or Archaludon Flash Cannon, then handle Maushold. Save Noivern for Dragapult speed matchups. Noivern 192 outspeeds all except max Dragapult.

decisions.rationale: Floette 42% dies to BP and FC; Protect saves it. FM redirects BP/FC onto Maushold (resists Steel). PopBomb weak into Steels; attacking wastes the turn while Floette dies.
Bring H-Arcanine for Intimidate chip on Scizor Atk and LO FlareBlitz; rain cuts Fire but Scizor -1 Def makes KO likely. Floette must Pass. Ape weaker into this pair now.

CC on Maushold is SE regardless of Follow Me redirect; Flash Cannon targets Floette for the KO at 41%. If no Follow Me, both attacks are productive (CC chips Maushold, Flash Cannon KOs Floette). If Follow Me, CC still does big damage to Maushold while Flash Cannon is only partially wasted. Mega Evolve Scizor for immediate stat boost. CC drops are acceptable given Floette KO is the series win condition.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Politoed fainted T1. Rain 4 turns left. Scizor-Mega Atk 222 with 252 Atk EVs (inferred from base Scizor 200 Atk). BP+Technician KOs Floette at 41% if unredirected. Flash Cannon also KOs at 41%. Opponent likely repeats Follow Me to protect Floette. CC on Maushold is the hedge. Floette Light of Ruin 1/2 recoil—at 41% HP, self-KO risk if used again; expect Moonblast. Back: Arcanine-Hisui (4x Fire threat to Scizor, Intimidate), Annihilape (Defiant—avoid Intimidate), Dragapult (Focus Sash, 178-213 Spe), Basculegion (Adaptability Aqua Jet priority). Noivern 192 outspeeds all except max Dragapult. Save Noivern for Dragapult. Scizor-Mega 95 Spe (0 Spe EVs inferred)—still slow, rely on BP priority.

decisions.rationale: Rain Blitz still KOs -1Def Scizor after its prio; Technician BP KOs 42% Floette even at -1 Atk, and consecutive Protect is unreliable. Switch Annihilape out of the BP/FC while deleting Mega Scizor; Ape+Arc pressure Arch and backline.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Arch+Politoed rain, Mega Scizor Technician, Prankster Grimm clay, Noivern sash, Staraptor WideLens. Our core: Mega Floette Fairy Aura; H-Arcanine Intim/LO; Annihilape Defiant/RageFist; Maushold FG/FM. Priority delete Scizor with Blitz; Ape breaks Arch. Respect Grimm FakeOut/screens and Noivern sash Infiltrator.

decisions.rationale: Scizor Protect blocks the 4x Flare Blitz (guaranteed, first use). Flash Cannon is a guaranteed KO on Floette at 41% if it connects. Floette's Protect is at reduced success rate so it likely fails. If Floette does Protect, Scizor is still safe and we retry next turn. Double-targeting trades Scizor for Floette — much worse than keeping Scizor alive while still likely KOing Floette. Main risk is Arcanine predicting Protect and Close Combating Archaludon, but Flare Blitz on the 4x-weak Scizor is the

Key win condition: KO Floette, preserve Scizor for late-game priority, save Noivern for Dragapult speed tie.

decisions.rationale: Def-1 Scizor dies to rain-weakened LO Blitz (outspeeds; no prio KO threat). Ape CC chips/KOs Arch (Stamina after). Arc moves first vs both. Accept Arch speed ties; Protect lines stall worse.

decisions.rationale: Flare Blitz is a possible OHKO on Scizor even in rain (45-140%). Switch to Noivern who takes only 7-25% from Flare Blitz. Archaludon Protects to avoid double Close Combat (57-102% each). Next turn Noivern (192 Spe) outspeeds all: Super Fang halves Arcanine HP, Electro Shot KOs. Preserve Archaludon for Flash Cannon on Floette (41%).

Ice Punch 4x on Noivern (Flying/Dragon)—beware Annihilape targeting switch-in. Electro Shot in rain: one-turn, raises SpA +1. Plan: T5 Noivern Super Fang + Archaludon Electro Shot on Arcanine for KO, then Flash Cannon Floette.

decisions.rationale: Sash already broken. Noivern outspeeds and OHKOes Ape with Hurricane, so Ape must Protect. ES prio chips Noivern (23-54%) into easy Ice Punch range next; Arc cannot KO it this turn. CC Arch is alternate pressure but Stamina-ups and leaves Noivern healthy.

Double-target Annihilape with Hurricane (100% acc in rain, 56-120%) + Flash Cannon (neutral 1x, 26-57%). Combined minimum 82% > 70% HP = guaranteed KO, eliminating the 4x Ice Punch OHKO threat on Noivern. Arcanine likely KOs Archaludon with Close Combat (95-112% + Life Orb), but Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch KOs Floette at 41% (2x SE Technician STAB) and Close Combat 2x SE on Arcanine. Noivern's 192 Spe outspeeds everything remaining. Flash Cannon preserves SpA if Archaludon survives.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 facts: Flash Cannon is NEUTRAL (1x) on Annihilape (Steel vs Fighting=1x, vs Ghost=1x), not NVE. Arcanine Close Combat on Archaludon = 95-112% (near-guaranteed OHKO, worse with Life Orb). Hurricane+Flash Cannon double-target guarantees Annihilape KO (82% min > 70% HP). Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch KOs Floette at 41% (2x SE Technician STAB). Scizor Close Combat 2x SE on Arcanine-Hisui (Fighting vs Rock). Rain expires end of T5; Hurricane reverts to 70% acc T6+. Key win path: KO Annihilape T5, sacrifice Archaludon, Scizor-Mega cleans Floette+Arcanine with priority and Noivern speed. Avoid Intimidate on Annihilape (Defiant). Noivern Focus Sash broken (at 73% HP).

decisions.rationale: Noivern sash gone at 31%. ES pri KO Noivern before it acts; Ape Ice Punch also KOs or chips if Protect. Arch slower/equal; delete flyer now, pressure Arch next. Avoid free SE Hurricane on Ape.

Switch Noivern to Scizor brings in my win condition safely. Opponent's natural play is ES the Noivern slot (6-13% on Scizor via Steel resist) + CC Archaludon (blocked by Protect). Scizor then cleans with Bullet Punch priority on Floette and Close Combat on Arcanine. Only losing line is opponent predicting switch and Flare Blitzing the slot, which is low-probability given Noivern at 32% screams Protect, not switch.

Avoid Intimidate on Annihilape (Defiant). Annihilape likely faster than Archaludon (Jolly 121-156 vs 123).

decisions.rationale: Frozen Scizor dies to LO Blitz (174%+ OHKO) before it can act if thawed. Arc outspeeds Arch; Ape CC chips/KOs Arch (64-109%). Delete Mega now; pressure Stamina Arch.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Arcanine's CC can't OHKO Archaludon (35-73%), so if Arcanine moves first, Archaludon still gets Draco Meteor off. Protect is only ~33% reliable after last-turn use. Arch 18% dies to Ape CC; Floette Protects through thaw BP and any FC. Keeps both for Scizor. Attacking Arch with Floette risks thaw BP KO on 42% Floette.

Archaludon is guaranteed dead to CC at 19% regardless, so get max value: Flash Cannon (2x SE on Floette) chips 19-40%, and if Scizor thaws (20%), Bullet Punch (priority +1, 37-85%) + Flash Cannon = guaranteed KO on Floette at 41%. If Floette Protects, I force a wasted turn. Protecting Archaludon only delays since SpA-2 is permanent and opponents can target frozen Scizor instead.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Scizor BP prio threatens Floette 42%; Protect guarantees safety (even reduced). Ape CC KOs or nearly KOs 76% Scizor (neutral Fighting, no Defiant needed). Double attack risks Floette death before Ape moves if Scizor BPs.

Bullet Punch has priority +1 so Scizor moves first. Min roll 42% of max HP exceeds Floette's 41% current HP — guaranteed KO if Floette doesn't Protect. Floette's Protect success is reduced (~33%). If it does Protect, Scizor still survives Annihilape's Close Combat (max 58.6% < 77% HP). No other move option is competitive: CC is immune to Annihilape and 0.5x on Floette; U-turn is 0.25x on Annihilape. This is the only path to remove Floette and reach a 1v1, even if unfavorable.

decisions.rationale: Floette fainted: must Pass. Ape outspeeds Scizor; CC is neutral and strongest KO try on 32% after prior chip. Rage Fist weaker (0.5x Steel). Protect stalls needlessly. Immune to CC; BP is only real damage.

Scizor has priority BP so always moves first. At -3 Def, BP does ~45-82% (18-33% base ×2.5). If Annihilape CCs back, ~10-17% chance Scizor survives at 33%. If it survives, T11 BP at -4 Def does ~54-99%, likely KOing before Annihilape can act. Protect doesn't improve odds since blocked CC doesn't drop defenses further. BP is faster and punishes weak-move calls. Only win path is BP chip + survive one CC + priority KO.

reflections.summary: Won cleanly (0 errors) as Arcanine removed sash Noivern and chipped, Ice Punch froze Mega Scizor, and Defiant Annihilape Close Combats broke Stamina Arch then finished Scizor; Mega Floette support was incidental and got Bullet Punched.
reflections.adjustment: Question G1 preview: Mega Floette is a poor fit into Adamant Mega Scizor (resists Fairy, Bullet Punch deletes it) + Arch; next game prefer Arcanine/Annihilape/Maushold core and only bring Floette if Grimm screens or no Scizor shown.
reflections.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina Leftovers Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect). G1 left Grimm clay + Staraptor WideLens home. Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. Our core same; priority Blitz/ES Scizor, respect sash Infiltrator + potential Grimm FakeOut/screens.

reflections.summary: The team had no effective answer to Annihilape. Archaludon is Fighting-weak and fell to repeated Close Combats. Scizor-Mega cannot meaningfully damage Annihilape (Bullet Punch neutral, Close Combat immune, U-turn 0.25x), so Annihilape's Leftovers healing outpaced Scizor's damage in the endgame. The Politoed+Archaludon rain core was ineffective—rain expired by T5, leaving Electro Shot unusable and Archaludon as a sitting duck. Noivern was sacrificed at 32% to bring in Scizor, leaving no speed con
reflections.adjustment: For game 2, do not bring the Politoed+Archaludon rain core unless you can guarantee sustained rain; it is too slow and Fighting-weak against this opponent. Lead Scizor-Mega aggressively to remove Floette and Arcanine early with priority, and keep a healthier Noivern or a different slot to outspeed and KO Annihilape before Scizor is forced into a losing 1v1. Consider substituting Archaludon or Politoed for a Pokemon that can hit Annihilape super-effectively.
reflections.notebook: Opponent roster: Annihilape (Leftovers, Defiant, Jolly, CC/Ice Punch/Rage Fist/Protect), Maushold (Wide Lens, Friend Guard, Jolly, Follow Me/Tidy Up), Floette-Mega (Floettite, Fairy Aura, Modest, Moonblast/Light of Ruin/Energy Ball/Protect), Arcanine-Hisui (Life Orb, Intimidate, Jolly, Flare Blitz/CC/ES), Dragapult (Focus Sash, Clear Body, Timid, not yet brought), Basculegion (Sitrus, Adaptability, Adamant, not yet brought). Opponent plays aggressively: repeated Close Combats despite defense drops, Floette-Mega Protects frequently (3x in 10 turns). Annihilape out-heals Scizor's neutral Bullet Punch with Leftovers. Scizor-Mega hard-walls Floette-Mega (0.25-0.5x from all Floette moves) and KOs with Bullet Punch. Arcanine Flare Blitz OHKOs Scizor (4x). Avoid Intimidate on Annihilape (Defiant). Rain core (Politoed+Archaludon) is unreliable: Electro Shot is two-turn outside rain, rain lasts only 5 turns, Archaludon is Fighting-weak. For game 2: need a dedicated Annihilape answer; consider bringing Noivern at full HP to outspeed and Draco Meteor Annihilape, or substitute a Pokemon with super-effective coverage. Dragapult and Basculegion have not been seen yet—expect one or both next game.
